item_short_desc: Rothco’s Kerosene Hurricane Lantern combines timeless design with reliable functionality, making it a must-have for camping trips, outdoor adventures, or as a backup light during power outages. The lantern features a durable metal construction with a wire-covered glass globe for added protection. Its adjustable control knob and cotton wick let you customize the brightness to suit your needs. With an 8-ounce fuel capacity, the lantern provides extended burn time when filled with kerosene oil (fuel not included).
